title: Bubble Wrap Was First Made to Be Wallpaper
description:
Bubble Wrap was first made in 1957 as textured wallpaper, and it only took off when IBM used it to ship computers.
Follow MarketOpsTips for the stories behind big brands.

#business #bubblewrap #shorts

beats.say: Bubble Wrap was supposed to go on your walls.
In 1957, two engineers, Alfred Fielding and Marc Chavannes, had an odd idea.
They sealed two shower curtains together to make textured wallpaper.
The wallpaper flopped. So they tried it as greenhouse insulation.
Then IBM used it to ship its computers, and Bubble Wrap took off.
Would you have put Bubble Wrap on your wall?
